00040 #ifndef _UGEN_ugen_Bits_H_
00041 #define _UGEN_ugen_Bits_H_
00042 
00044 typedef union 
00045 { 
00046   unsigned long u;
00047   long i;
00048   float f;

00055 class Bits
00056 {
00057 public:
00058   static inline long countLeadingZeros(long x)
00059   {
00060     x |= (x >> 1);
00061     x |= (x >> 2);
00062     x |= (x >> 4);
00063     x |= (x >> 8);
00064     x |= (x >> 16);
00065     return(32 - countOnes(x));
00066   }
00067 
00068   static inline long countTrailingZeros(long x) 
00069   {
00070     return 32 - countLeadingZeros(~x & (x-1));
00071   }
00072   
00073   static inline long countLeadingOnes(long x) 
00074   {
00075     return countLeadingZeros(~x);
00076   }
00077   
00078   static inline long countTrailingOnes(long x) 
00079   {
00080     return 32 - countLeadingZeros(x & (~x-1));
00081   }
00082   
00083   static inline long numBitsRequired(long x) 
00084   {
00085     return 32 - countLeadingZeros(x);
00086   }
00087   
00088   static inline long log2Ceil(long x) 
00089   {
00090     return 32 - countLeadingZeros(x - 1);
00091   }
00092   
00093   static inline long nextPowerOf2(long x) 
00094   {
00095     return 1L << log2Ceil(x);
00096   }
00097   
00098   static inline bool isPowerOf2(long x) 
00099   {
00100     return (x & (x-1)) == 0;
00101   }
00102 
00103   static inline unsigned long countOnes(unsigned long x)
00104   {
00105     x -= ((x >> 1) & 0x55555555);
00106         x = (((x >> 2) & 0x33333333) + (x & 0x33333333));
00107         x = (((x >> 4) + x) & 0x0f0f0f0f);
00108         x += (x >> 8);
00109         x += (x >> 16);
00110         return(x & 0x0000003f);   
00111   }
00112   
00113   static inline void endianSwap(unsigned short& x)
00114   {
00115     x = (x >> 8) | 
00116       (x << 8);
00117   }
00118   
00119   static inline void endianSwap(short& x)
00120   {
00121     return endianSwap((unsigned short&)x);
00122   }
00123   
00124   static inline void endianSwap(unsigned int& x)
00125   {
00126     x = (x >> 24) | 
00127       ((x << 8) & 0x00FF0000) |
00128       ((x >> 8) & 0x0000FF00) |
00129       (x << 24);
00130     
00131   }
00132   
00133   static inline void endianSwap(int& x)
00134   {
00135     return endianSwap((unsigned int&)x);
00136   }
00137   
00138 };
